words.definition: the condition of your body and mind.
words.example: Eating vegetables is good for your health.

words.definition: a disease or period of being sick.
words.example: She missed school because of an illness.

words.definition: feeling ill or unwell.
words.example: He felt too sick to go to work.

words.definition: a person trained to treat sick people.
words.example: I went to see the doctor yesterday.

words.definition: a person trained to take care of sick people, usually in a hospital.
words.example: The nurse checked my temperature.

words.definition: a place where sick or injured people get medical care.
words.example: He was taken to the hospital by ambulance.

words.definition: a substance used to treat an illness.
words.example: Take this medicine twice a day.

words.definition: an uncomfortable feeling in your body caused by illness or injury.
words.example: I have a pain in my back.

words.definition: a pain in your head.
words.example: I have a headache, so I need to rest.

words.definition: a higher than normal body temperature caused by illness.
words.example: My son has a fever and a cough.

words.definition: a sudden noisy push of air out of your throat, often caused by illness.
words.example: She has a bad cough.

words.definition: a common illness that makes you sneeze and cough.
words.example: I caught a cold last week.

words.definition: a sign in your body that shows you have an illness.
words.example: A high temperature is a symptom of the flu.

words.definition: damage to part of your body caused by an accident.
words.example: He got an injury while playing football.

words.definition: to relax or sleep in order to feel better.
words.example: You should rest until you feel better.

words.definition: an arranged time to meet someone, such as a doctor.
words.example: I have a doctor's appointment at three o'clock.

words.definition: a paper from a doctor that lets you buy medicine.
words.example: The doctor gave me a prescription for the pain.

words.definition: in good physical or mental condition.
words.example: Eating fruit helps you stay healthy.

words.definition: physical activity that keeps your body healthy.
words.example: Regular exercise is good for your heart.

words.definition: to become well again after an illness.
words.example: It took two weeks to recover from the flu.

text: Last month, I felt very sick for a few days. It started with a headache and a fever, and then I began to cough a lot. I thought it was just a cold, but the symptoms got worse, so I decided to make an appointment with my doctor. At the clinic, a nurse checked my temperature and asked about my pain. The doctor said I had the flu, which is a common illness in winter. She gave me a prescription for some medicine and told me to rest at home for a week. I didn't need to go to the hospital because my illness wasn't serious. I stayed in bed, drank a lot of water, and took my medicine every day. My mother cooked healthy food for me, like soup with vegetables. After a week of rest, I started to feel better and slowly began to recover. The doctor also said that regular exercise and a healthy diet can help prevent illness in the future. Now I try to stay active and eat well so I don't get sick again. I learned that taking care of your health is very important.
